newsitem.title: GERMANY: Altana says Q1 sales up 12 percent.
newsitem.headline: Altana says Q1 sales up 12 percent.

text.p: German drugs and chemicals group Altana AG said on Friday first quarter 1997 sales rose around 12 percent to 623 million marks despite virtually stagnant pharmaceutical sales.
In a business statement, the group said it expected total 1997 sales of around 2.5 billion marks compared to the 2.27 billion recorded in 1996 with profits rising "accordingly".

For the first quarter, an exceptionally high turnover in the previous year-period and a weak domestic market meant that for this year, pharmaceuticals sales gained just three percent to 415 million marks.
Acquisitions in its chemicals arm meanwhile meant turnover there rose 38 percent to 208 million marks in the first three months of 1997.
